title: Eldritch Moon Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Emrakul, the Promised End
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan, an enigma, called to Innistrad by Nahiri through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Yeter
entities.description: A villager of Trostad.

entities.name: Trostad
entities.description: A village on Innistrad.

entities.name: Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
entities.description: The melded form of Sigarda's corrupted sisters Bruna and Gisela.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: The last uncorrupted archangel of Innistrad, who supports the Order of Saint Traft.

entities.name: Bruna, the Fading Light
entities.description: An archangel, sister of Sigarda, who now sees only Emrakul's visions.

entities.name: Gisela, the Broken Blade
entities.description: An archangel, sister of Sigarda, who now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch who fought alongside Liliana.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who fought beside Gideon and swore an oath to keep watch.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers deployed on Innistrad.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: An order that found new strength with Sigarda's support.

entities.name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
entities.description: A cathar who rejects the Lunarch Council and believes salvation must be earned.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: The ruling council of the church that Thalia rejects.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who called Emrakul to Innistrad and blames Sorin.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The vast emptiness between the planes.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Emrakul arrived.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city on Innistrad whose streets ghouls surged through.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire of the Stromkirk line.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Nahiri blames for what befell him.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A trapper of Kessig.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region of Innistrad.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who believes any suffering plane can be restored.

entities.name: Ricton
entities.description: A traveling merchant who escaped the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: A forest on Innistrad.

entities.name: Heron

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer, sister of Geralf.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher, brother of Gisa, who admires Ludevic's genius.

entities.name: Ludevic

entities.name: Hanweir

events.summary: Sigarda discovers what has become of her sisters and weeps.
events.quote: Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.

events.summary: Bruna is corrupted, seeing only Emrakul's visions.
events.quote: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

events.summary: Gisela is corrupted, hearing only Emrakul's murmurs.
events.quote: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

events.summary: Gideon and Liliana fight side by side despite disagreements.
events.quote: Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.

events.summary: Sigarda supports the Order of Saint Traft.
events.quote: The Order of Saint Traft found new strength with Sigarda's support.

events.summary: Nahiri calls Emrakul through the Blind Eternities to Innistrad.
events.quote: At Nahiri's call, Emrakul traversed the vast emptiness between the planes and arrived on Innistrad.

events.summary: Emrakul is imprisoned in the moon.
events.quote: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

rejected.summary: Ghouls surge through Thraben, bringing the city's salvation.
rejected.quote: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.
Ludevic saw it in a dream and set to work immediately, every detail already known.
